description.p: Knitt is a Git client for Linux, built with Tauri and libgit2. It covers the everyday workflow without a terminal: staging and committing, branches, history rewriting, merges and rebases with a conflict editor, and Git LFS.
GitHub integration is part of the app:

ul.li: Sign in to GitHub with the OAuth device flow, so no token is copied
Pull requests and issues for the open repository
Recent Actions runs, with the log of each job

description.p: Diffs and conflicts open in an editor with syntax highlighting. The history panel handles amend, reword, squash and reorder, and tags, stashes, the reflog and remotes each have a view of their own.
